narrative.intro: B I has obligated $254M in FY2026 to date across five awards, with an average award size of $50.8M and obligations up 33.4% year over year. Fiscal-year obligations have varied: FY21 was $281M, FY22 was $270M, FY23 was $314M, FY24 was $288M, and FY25 was $190M. Facilities Support Services is the dominant market for B I, accounting for $247M of obligations in FY2026 to date. Investigation and Personal Background Check Services is a distant second at $6.5M. The total obligations figure is a partial, fiscal year to date amount and the award-size figure is the mean of the five awards recorded for the current year. The concentration in Facilities Support Services suggests most current-year contract value sits in that NAICS. The fiscal history shows a peak in FY23 at $314M and a trough in FY25 at $190M, with FY26 year-to-date obligations at $254M representing the current partial-year position.
